errors.text_span: with tick marks at regular intervals
errors.evidence: The x-axis is on a logarithmic scale, as stated in its label, so the intervals between the tick marks are not regular.
The Precision line (red) ends at a value visibly lower than its starting point. It starts at approximately 78% but ends at approximately 76%, not 78%.
The F1-score (purple line) ends at a value of approximately 56% at 7.0B, not 58%. The data point is just over halfway between the 40% and 60% gridlines.

The description correctly identifies which line corresponds to which metric, but it fails to explicitly mention the presence and location of the legend in the bottom-right corner, which provides this mapping.
